scope: Proposition 3.4 of the manuscript “An L² Einstein Gap for Nonnegatively Curved Four-Manifolds” (preprints/An-L2-Einstein-Gap-for-Nonnegatively-Curved-Four-Manifolds-October-5-2026/einstein-gap.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 348 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3be17e2ac8ba5f5f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For all sufficiently large j, the flow gj(t) exists on [0, T]. There is a uniform constant A such that max Mj | Rmgj(t) | ≤ A t , 0 < t < T. (3.13)
